hypothesis: Rank tests depend on cell CDFs and zero fractions, not only moments. Fit query NTC detection and positive-count shape; calibrate a relative NB detection response around empirical zeros, retaining binary control-cell dependence or testing independent detection. Empirical-scaled control transport is a comparator related to old V29, now at exact V66 realized margins. Specified without consulting V78/V79 DE summaries.
fit: Fit per-gene detection hazard against library offsets to observed average fraction nonzero (10 Newton moment iterations). Fit overdispersion of positive excess counts (X-1) conditional on positive cells/depth; shrink toward NTC alpha with npositive/(npositive+20). Use observed control bulk rate, alpha and median/mean depths; no query treatment input.
generation: Detection target uses logit empirical control detection plus logit NB-detection(mu_target,alpha)-logit NB-detection(mu_control,alpha). Cap detection<=mu_target to permit positive integer counts. Couple uniforms to actual control-template detection for coupled arm, independent uniforms otherwise. Given detection, sample1+NB(excess mean=mu_target/detection-1, fitted positive alpha). Condition at least one positive for a gene whose fixed parent total is positive. Exact V29 row/gene/CPM projection then enforces published V66 margins. Unsupported and current own genes receive no direct proposal; repair may affect carrier genes.
negative: Shuffle hazard, control alpha and positive alpha jointly among eligible genes within10 baseline-expression bins; couple against genuine template/control detection. Empirical arm permutes template gene columns within expression bins then rescales and projects. Norm matching of final cells not claimed.
constraints: Exact original row and gene counts => exact raw bulk profiles/PDS. Revert if CPM L1>.0005 or moved fraction>.35. Jackknife expression correction/DE means may change and are explicitly not protected.
selection: Same precision-focused V79 criterion, frozen before outcomes: development first2 unique cases/context; fidelity>=baseline+.01, Jaccard>=baseline+.001, reach>=baseline-.02, available-study NMAE<=1.01 and fidelity/Jaccard better than shuffled. Highest fidelity, tie Jaccard; no failed-guard fallback.
confirmation: Remaining20 cases, two seeds0/+620000, unchanged model. Both must pass critical criteria before production, exact profile/PDS and independent raw-p/rank checks. All public biology reused; not a hidden overall forecast or proof of true RNA kinetics.
